common.run_test: Come back here and choose Test forwarding. The test mail should arrive within a minute.

gmail.step_1: In Gmail, open Settings, See all settings, Forwarding and POP/IMAP, and choose Add a forwarding address.
gmail.step_2: Enter {{.forwarding_address}}. Gmail mails a confirmation code to it, and the code shows on this page within a minute.
gmail.step_3: Enter the code in Gmail, then choose Forward a copy of incoming mail to {{.forwarding_address}}.
gmail.step_4: Keep Gmail's copy in the inbox and save the changes.
gmail.warning_sent_folder: Replies you send from dimmi do not show in Gmail's Sent folder unless you connect the mailbox.

google_workspace.step_1: In the Google Admin console, open Apps, Google Workspace, Gmail, Routing.
google_workspace.step_2: Under Routing, choose Configure and name the rule dimmi {{.address}}.
google_workspace.step_3: Under Email messages to affect, tick Inbound and Internal - receiving.
google_workspace.step_4: Under Envelope filter, choose Only affect specific envelope recipients, Single recipient, and enter {{.address}}.
google_workspace.step_5: Under Also deliver to, choose Add more recipients, Add, Basic, and enter {{.forwarding_address}}.
google_workspace.step_6: Under Options, Account types to affect, tick Users, Groups and Unrecognized / Catch-all.
google_workspace.step_7: Save the rule. No confirmation code is needed.
google_workspace.warning_delay: Google says a new rule can take up to 24 hours. It usually works within minutes, and the test can stay red until then.
google_workspace.warning_not_admin: Not a Google Workspace admin? Use the Gmail steps, or send these instructions to whoever runs your Google account.

google_group.step_1: Add the routing rule from the Google Workspace steps for {{.address}}, with Groups ticked under account types.
google_group.step_2: Remove {{.forwarding_address}} from the group's members if you added it.
google_group.step_3: Keep the group for the people who read it, if you like. The rule passes each message on unchanged.
google_group.warning_via_sender: A group rewrites each sender to "Name via {{.address}}" and can hold mail for moderation. The routing rule keeps the customer as the sender.

microsoft_365.step_1: In the Exchange admin center, open Recipients, Mailboxes, and choose {{.address}}.
microsoft_365.step_2: Under Mail flow settings, open Email forwarding and forward to the external address {{.forwarding_address}}.
microsoft_365.step_3: Keep a copy of forwarded mail in the mailbox and save.
microsoft_365.warning_outbound_policy: Microsoft 365 blocks automatic forwarding to other domains by default, and mail bounces with 5.7.520. In Microsoft Defender, open the outbound anti-spam policy and set Automatic forwarding to On for this mailbox.
microsoft_365.warning_shared_mailbox: A shared mailbox needs an admin to set the forward. A rule in Outlook only works for a licensed user.

outlook_com.step_1: In Outlook.com, open Settings, Mail, Forwarding.
outlook_com.step_3: Tick Keep a copy of forwarded messages and save.

fastmail.step_1: In Fastmail, open Settings, Filters & Rules, and add a rule for mail sent to {{.address}}.
fastmail.step_3: Keep the copy in your inbox and save the rule.

icloud.step_1: In iCloud Mail on the web, open Settings, General, Forwarding.
icloud.step_2: Turn on Forward my email to and enter {{.forwarding_address}}.
icloud.step_3: Keep the copy in iCloud and save.
icloud.warning_whole_mailbox: iCloud forwards the whole mailbox, not one address, so every mail to this account reaches dimmi.

yahoo.step_1: In Yahoo Mail, open Settings, More Settings, Mailboxes, and choose {{.address}}.
yahoo.step_2: Under Forwarding, enter {{.forwarding_address}} and choose Verify.
yahoo.step_3: Open the verification mail that arrives here and confirm, then choose Store and forward.
yahoo.warning_paid_plan: Yahoo only offers forwarding on some plans.

zoho.step_1: In Zoho Mail, open Settings, Mail Forwarding and POP/IMAP.
zoho.step_2: Add {{.forwarding_address}} as a forwarding address and enter the code Zoho mails to it; it shows on this page.
zoho.step_3: Turn forwarding on and keep a copy in the mailbox.

cpanel.step_1: In cPanel, open Email, Forwarders, and choose Add Forwarder.
cpanel.step_2: Enter {{.address}} as the address to forward and {{.forwarding_address}} as the destination.
cpanel.step_3: Save. cPanel keeps delivering to the mailbox too.

cloudflare_routing.step_1: In the Cloudflare dashboard, open {{.domain}}, Email, Email Routing, Destination addresses, and add {{.forwarding_address}}.
cloudflare_routing.step_2: Confirm it with the link Cloudflare mails there; that mail shows in the activity on this page.
cloudflare_routing.step_3: Under Routing rules, create a custom address {{.address}} that sends to {{.forwarding_address}}.

generic.step_1: In your mail service's settings, find mail forwarding or forwarders.
generic.step_2: Forward every message sent to {{.address}} to {{.forwarding_address}}, and keep a copy if you like.
generic.warning_no_alias: Use a forward, not an alias that sends mail on as your own address, so each customer stays the sender.
